# Method GetFinishingParameterValue

#### GetFinishingParameterValue(ElementId, out DocumentId, out FinishingCategoryType)

Gets Document and Category from a finishing Parameter

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 20, 296, 0)]
void GetFinishingParameterValue(ElementId inParameterId, out DocumentId outDocumentId, out FinishingCategoryType outFinishingType)
```

| --- | --- | --- |
